name: Cryxian Monstrosity
description:
This model is a monstrosity that can be included in a Cryxian warcaster's battlegroup. A Cryxian warcaster can allocate focus points to this model as if it was a warjack. If this model's warcaster is destroyed or removed from the table, it becomes autonomous. A Cryxian warcaster can take control of an autonomous friendly Cryxian monstrosity. To do this, a Cryxian warcaster must spend 1 focus point during its activation while B2B with the autonomous Cryxian monstrosity. The monstrosity must forfeit its Combat Action the turn it becomes controlled. The monstrosity becomes a part of the battlegroup of the warcaster that took control of it.

At any time during its activation, a Cryxian warcaster can spend focus points to heal damage a monstrosity in its battlegroup in its control range has suffered. For each focus point spent this way, remove 1 damage point.

name: Crater
description:
This terrain feature is rough terrain.

A model completely within the area of this terrain feature has cover from attacks made by models that are not within the area of the same terrain feature. Models completely within this terrain feature do not suffer blast damage unless the origin of the damage is centered in the area of the same terrain feature. When drawing line of sight to a model not completely within a crater terrain feature, ignore models that are completely within a crater, open grave template, or one or more trench templates.

name: Forests
description:
This terrain feature is rough terrain and provides concealment to a model completely inside its area.

When drawing line of sight to or from a point to or from a point within a forest terrain feature, the line of sight can pass through up to 3" of the forest without being blocked; anything more blocks it. When a model outside a forest attempts to draw line of sight to another point also outside that forest, the forest blocks line of sight to anything beyond it. Thus, a model can see 3" into or out of a forest but not completely through one regardless of how thick it is. 

Forest do not block line of sight to huge-based models.

name: Orgoth Monstrosity

To do this, an Orgoth warcaster must spend 1 focus point during its activation while B2B with the autonomous Orgoth monstrosity. The monstrosity must forfeit its Combat Action the turn it becomes controlled. The monstrosity becomes a part of the battlegroup of the warcaster that took control of it.

At any time during its activation, an Orgoth warcaster can spend focus points to heal damage a monstrosity in its battlegroup in its control range has suffered. For each focus point spent this way, remove 1 damage point.
